head: center_logits
design: Same already-reviewed113 original FIT scenes and8 complete-negative TRAIN scenes; original16 grouped holdout excluded from optimization and normalization. Extract frozen24-channel features. Control sets negative term to zero; background weight1. Deterministic convex Newton solve with backtracking; no seed or threshold sweep.
frozen: All backbone weights, all geometry weights and red scoring weights/bias must remain bitwise unchanged. Model graph and runtime operations unchanged. Normalization is offboard optimizer-only and folded into blue head weights.
evaluation: Verify convergence and saved checkpoint identity, unchanged red/geometry outputs, then TFLite tensor/decoded-proposal parity on137frames. Evaluate both fixed arms on complete64 TRAIN scenes and all three repeated development panels with current classifier, blue-bright search and confidence selection. No selection on holdout/development. No runtime swap.
